name: The Chess Club
description: Regulars at the chess club each swear by a different opening, a favourite tactic, and a prized set. Work out who plays what.
clues: Either Skewer goes with Garry or Zwischenzug goes with French.
Between Slav and Zwischenzug, one goes with Judit and the other with Vera.
Boris, Vera, and Zugzwang go with French, London, and Slav, in some order.
Either Benoni goes with Boris or someone in the Queen's-Pawn Camp goes with Vera.

hints.text: Suppose Boris went with Benoni — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Boris goes with Benoni.
Boris goes with Benoni, so it can't also go with French.

…but now the clue “Boris, Vera, and Zugzwang go with French, London, and Slav, in some order” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Boris does not go with Benoni.
